item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\ncases = [\\n ({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{'ignored':['b']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'same','timestamp':1,'meta':{'z':1,'a':2}}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'same','timestamp':1,'meta':{'a':2,'z':2}}}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'irrelevant':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n]\\nfor req, pol, expected in cases:\\n rb, pb = copy.deepcopy(req), copy.deepcopy(pol)\\n actual=evaluate(req,pol)\\n assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)\\n assert req==rb and pol==pb\\nprint('boundary cases passed',len(cases))\"]}}]}"}
